hookTimeouts.readBy: a hold waits no longer than the agent lets a hook run

continuation.readBy: only a turn's end may send a claim back: the plugin sends the hub's words as the session's next prompt

launch.readBy: DeepBuild starts no job through paseo: the plugin only gates the agents paseo runs

install.readBy: setup installs the plugin through paseo's own manager, at the one version these facts cover

modelFamily.readBy: which rate card and context window a model name belongs to

billing.readBy: whether a session bills a plan or an API account: paseo runs each agent with its own sign-in

usage.readBy: each agent's own adapter counts its usage; paseo's turn end carries none
usage.tokens: none: each agent's own adapter reads them

questionTools.readBy: which tool calls are questions to the person, so each one is caught as a permission request of kind question

transcripts.readBy: paseo keeps each agent's saved file; the plugin reads none, since each agent keeps its own history

appLinks.open: none: paseo's app opens an agent by its own ID

errorTexts.readBy: a stop's cause from the error the agent reports, never from its words; a stop that matches none is unknown, never a pass

events.readBy: a payload is held to its version's strict schema: a missing or retyped field marks the session unverified

mapping.readBy: the adapter maps each hook payload to events by these entries, and deep explain names the entry behind each event; a value names a payload field, or =text a constant

toolKinds.readBy: a tool call's kind (shell, read, edit, write, search, fetch, mcp or unknown, which guards treat as change), by tool name or name prefix

toolDetail.readBy: what a call of each kind carries: a shell call's command

claude.readBy: deep-hook gates Claude Code's sessions inside paseo, since paseo appends its hooks to yours: the plugin relays

codex.readBy: deep-hook gates Codex's sessions inside paseo, which run through app-server with your Codex home: the plugin relays

pi.readBy: the pi package gates pi's sessions inside paseo: the plugin relays

copilot.readBy: the plugin gates GitHub Copilot's ACP sessions, which have no hooks of their own
copilot.permissions: Each tool call asks through ACP's session/request_permission with allow_once, allow_always and reject_once options; only allow_once is ever chosen, from your decision or your answer, never by default.
copilot.modelCheck: The session's model, as paseo's snapshot reads it in runtimeInfo.model, is checked against the model you picked before the first prompt goes in; a different one holds the prompt and asks you.
